style.backgroundSystem: full-bleed marigold #F1AC1E field printed with a hairline #FCF8EF tile-joint grid running to a low horizon, alternating with flat wine-red #7A2331 and paper-white #FCF8EF boards; never a scenic, outdoor or gradient backdrop
style.iconSystem: open-ring hairline pictogram squares and discs in #1F1C22 with the glyph left blank, single stroke weight, square-cornered folded note cards and empty numbered index capsules; no filled badges, no solid medallions, no 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: warm hard key around 4200K from the upper left with one crisp same-colour cast shadow thrown onto the field, a thin #FCF8EF edge line on the shoulder, no softbox falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent retro-grid menswear launch board system for a men's woven check shirt across the entire image set; fixed palette of marigold field #F1AC1E, wine-red insert board #7A2331, ink-charcoal type bars #1F1C22 and paper-white card stock #FCF8EF; warm hard key light around 4200K from the upper left throwing one crisp same-field cast shadow, never softbox falloff; heavy geometric sans-serif Chinese label slots with an oversized outlined latin display band kept letterless; open-ring hairline pictogram squares with blank glyphs, square-cornered folded note cards and empty numbered index capsules; garment worn open over a plain undershirt on a generic adult male figure cropped above the jaw or on an invisible ghost form, identical scale and shadow on every screen; no palette changes outside the four locked hexes, no mixed fonts, no scenic or gradient backgrounds, no invented fabric or measurement facts, no model face, no QR or membership badges.
noDrift: no mixed fonts and no serif, script or calligraphic lettering
no scenic, outdoor or gradient backgrounds and no softbox falloff
no invented fibre percentages, gram weights, measurements, size codes or care temperatures
no readable model face, no QR codes, membership badges or discount numerals
style.presentationRules: the shirt is worn open over a plain undershirt on a generic adult male figure cropped above the jaw, or shown on an invisible ghost form; garment scale, key-light direction and cast-shadow hardness stay identical on every screen
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper-white #FCF8EF card board, marigold #F1AC1E printed floor plane and a wine-red #7A2331 macro board
style.typography: one heavy geometric sans-serif for Chinese label slots plus an oversized outlined latin display band that is always kept letterless; every readable line is supplied later as a placeholder
